objective: Represent a bounded set of incompatible location beliefs without inventing probabilities, and make the verifier return insufficient_evidence when the evidence supports neither a confirmation nor a refutation.
decision_supported: Should the newest observation silently replace a contradictory one? No: that collapses an unresolved belief into a confident answer the evidence does not support.
acceptance: Two contradictory observations are both retained, bounded to two.
A conflict yields insufficient_evidence with EVIDENCE_CONFLICTING.
An undisputed observation still confirms, and an undisputed absence still refutes.
Conflicting and missing are distinct reason codes.
A migration note records that old snapshots are not relabelled.
stop_conditions: The change would need a public schema-version bump.
risks_and_fallbacks: A verifier that previously said refuted now says insufficient_evidence for a conflicting entity; that is the correction, and the claim names both readings.
